subject: Part 2a: LLM search-loop grader module
description: Build a standalone LLM grader module that acts as the agentic search-loop controller. Contract: given (intent, original_query, evidence_gathered_so_far, candidate_results, round_n), return {continue:bool, next_query:string|null (reformulated from intent+evidence), kept:[result keys judged relevant to the intent], abstain:bool, aggregate:string (final synthesized context for the searcher)}. Implement the prompt + call the existing LLM backend (reuse resolveJudgeBackend / the judge backend in lib/judge.js or lib/llm-backend.js so it shares config/automode). Pure module with dependency-injected backend so it unit-tests with a mocked LLM. NO integration yet (that is Part 2b). New file e.g. lib/subconscious/llm-grader.js + tests. Independent of Part 1.
